literal: A noble subject well having understood even if they speak, of those who are poor, the meaning of the words decline will suffer.
translation: Even if the poor speak with a deep and thorough understanding of a noble subject, the meaning of their words will lose its value.
modern: வறுமையுற்றவர் ஒரு நல்ல கருத்தை நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து உணர்ந்து சொன்னாலும், அவருடைய சொற்களின் பொருள் மதிப்பற்றதாகிப் போகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the harsh social reality of poverty, where a person's financial status dictates how their intellect is received. Even if a poor person speaks on a noble and valuable subject with profound understanding, society fails to appreciate it. The words they utter lose their weight and value simply because of the speaker's impoverished state. Thus, poverty robs a person not just of material wealth, but also of the intellectual respect they deserve.
